remarks: Welcome to this massive 423+ acre property that could make a great family legacy property! Located adjacent to the Olean Municipal airport, it would make for an incredible fly-in destination! With the Cuba lake public boat launch only about 3 miles away, keep a boat at the property for fishing and fun! Included is an 800+ sq.ft. partially finished cabin with a beautiful mountain view. The cabin is equipped with electric and is just waiting for your custom touches to make it truly yours. With two gated entrances, miles of trails great for ATV’s, hunting, hiking or snowmobiling, the possibilities are endless! The property also features 2 small stocked bass ponds and a year round stream. Along the stream are several natural beaver dams to attract waterfowl. The property has over 3200 feet of total road frontage along Yankee Rd and Union Valley and is a great mix of woods/timberland, thick wildlife habitat, and open meadows. The forested areas consist of hard and soft maple, black cherry, red oak, ash and hickory, along with a small spruce plantation. A recent 100% timber cruise would suggest that there is over 800,000 board feet of standing hardwood timber 13 inches and larger on the property. The timber resource is of excellent quality overall and should make for a nice long term investment. The terrain ranges from flat to moderately steep in places and makes for spectacular hunting! With edges and pinch points, water sources and mast producing trees (plus some wild apple trees), wildlife thrives in this area! Abundant deer, turkey, bear, waterfowl and plenty of small game make this property something extra special! All rights are included with the sale. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to own this true sportsman’s paradise!
